name: Soft Shadows via Cone Tracing
definition: Soft shadows are achieved by tracing a cone from the surface point $x$ towards the direction of the light. The cone aperture controls how soft and scattered the resulting shadow is. Only the occlusion value $α_2$ is accumulated at each step.
summary: Soft Shadows via Cone Tracing approximates soft shadow boundaries by casting cones to aggregate extinction, distinguishing itself by modeling light scattering in participating media.
